name: Guest emergency
description: Emergencies that involve guests away from home on a ship or in a property: muster and accounting, a person overboard, an alleged serious crime, a tower evacuation read against the in-house list, hurricane departures and shelter in place, a guest death or serious injury, a hotline script, and an outage of the property management system. Stays at coordination, accounting and notification; it carries no tactical or medical detail.
outsideParties: the US Coast Guard rescue coordination center
guests' families and next of kin

advisorRoles.name: Hotel or ship safety adviser
advisorRoles.description: Advises on muster, accounting methods, evacuation and the order of notifications.

advisorRoles.name: Guest care and family liaison adviser
advisorRoles.description: Advises on talking with families, hotline scripts and care for guests and crew.

glossary.definition: Counting persons at assembly stations against the manifest (ship) or the in-house guest list (property). Expected equals counted plus not accounted for; state the time of the count and the time of the list.
The property management system's list of registered guests by room. A printout is older than the live list; late check-ins are not on it.

46 U.S.C. 3507(g): the line telephones the nearest FBI field office as soon as possible after homicide, suspicious death, a missing US national, kidnapping, assault with serious bodily injury, certain sexual offenses, firing or tampering with the vessel, or theft over $10,000, files a written report on the Department of Transportation website, and keeps a complaint log open to the FBI and the Coast Guard.
Alarm, mark the position, turn the ship, post lookouts, call the Coast Guard rescue coordination center, muster to confirm identity, secure camera recordings.
The last time guests can leave by one method (shuttle, own vehicle, flight) before a road, causeway or airport closes; each window is tied to an advisory or closure time.

productConventions: Guests, crew and families appear as role codes (Guest A) or room codes; no real names or personal data.
Boards state the time of the count and of the list, and totals reconcile row by row.
Hurricane plans tie every action to an advisory time or a road or airport closure, in local time.
A notification checklist orders family first, then authorities and the consulate; the statement waits until the family is told.
realismRules: Camera footage is kept at least 20 days (46 U.S.C. 3507(b)).
Describe coordination, never injuries, methods or weapons.
A cabin or room is sealed and recordings secured before they are overwritten.
Ships, lines, hotels and people are fictional; real ports and cities are fine.

criticalTasks: Account for every guest and crew member and say how many are not accounted for at each time
Move guests to shelter or onward transport inside the departure windows
Notify family first, then the consulate, the medical examiner and the FBI where reportable
Hold the public statement until the family has been told
Telephone the FBI as soon as possible for a reportable incident
Secure evidence, recordings and the cabin
